join hortbot 2 foobar 1

simple_plaintext {"URL": "https://example.com", "Body": "This is an example.\n", "StatusCode": 200}
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add getsite (_TEXTAPI_https://example.com_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!getsite
send hortbot #foobar [HB] This is an example.

simple_plaintext {"URL": "https://example.com", "Body": "    This\nis\tan example.\n", "StatusCode": 404}
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!getsite
send hortbot #foobar [HB] This is an example.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add getsite (_TEXTAPI_https://example.com/?q=(_QESC_(_P_)_)_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!getsite hello there
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hey there.

send_any

send hortbot #foobar [HB] Not much, you?
